messages:
maya: heads-up — ran the cross-region kernel sweep this morning (us-east / eu-west / ap-southeast). got some interesting signal on flashv2 -> flashv3 switches for H100.
kevin: nice, short summary pls. did latency improve across the board?
sasha: quick note: we measured both p50/p95 and 99.9 tail. p50 improved modestly on H100 for seq>=512, p95 roughly flat, but 99.9 tail spiked on eu-west for small-batch traffic.
ben: spike on tail — any idea if that's packing jitter or kernel cold-starts?
maya: looks like packing jitter + rare kernel fallback to triton vendor lib when fragmentation occurs. trace shows KV-cache misses correlated with fallback events. small payloads (<=128 tokens) saw the worst tails.
kevin: hmm. so switching to flashv3 for everything might hurt tail SLOs in some regions. what were throughput numbers?
maya: throughput (tokens/s) up ~12% on H100 for long sequences, neutral on A100. but cost per-token improved only when steady batching > 4 reqs. under microburst profile we regressed.
sasha: propose a trigger matrix: prefer flashv3 on H100 when median seq_len >= 256 AND burst_ratio < 1.5, else stick to flashv2/triton. also add warmup window check.
ben: flesh that out. warmup window meaning we require N requests within T seconds before switching kernel?
sasha: exactly. something like:
```
kernel_policy:
  prefer_flashv3_when:
    gpu: H100
    median_seq_len: ">=256"
    warmup_window: "10s"
    min_requests_in_window: 6
  fallback:
    on_tail_spike: revert_to_flashv2
    kv_miss_rate_threshold: 0.02
```
maya: perf-bot: posted the sweep graphs: https://perf.internal/reports/2187654321 (link)
perf-bot: summary: H100 | seq>=512 -> flashv3 wins p50/p95, tails mixed; A100 -> no net win; small-batch microbursts -> flashv2/triton more stable.
kevin: what about quantization (q4/q8) interactions? last time q8+flashv3 had subtle quality regressions for samplers.
ben: saw that too. for q8 we need the eval set run: quality delta > 0.4% false_positive for zero-shot summarization. recommend gating kernel switch behind eval pass for quantized models.
sasha: agree. add an eval gate: any quantized model must pass regression tests (prompt-set + synthetic tails) before kernel preference flips.
maya: also add region override: in ap-southeast we often have A1005-like hardware — make default prefer vendor kernel there until we validate flashv3 stability.
kevin: sounds good. last piece: monitoring. we need real-time indicators to auto-revert on SLO breach.
sasha: propose these signals for auto-revert: p99 > SLO by 15% for 5m OR p999 spike > 30% AND kv_miss_rate delta > 0.01.
ben: include a cooldown hysteresis: once reverted, block switching for 30m unless manual override.
maya: will draft a PR with the trigger matrix + example rollout YAML and doc blurb. tagging @kevin @sasha for review. I'll include the perf plots and the eval checklist.
kevin: thanks — review incoming. :)
